payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear description of how models are evaluated in the human-machine communication game, focusing on efficiency and accuracy metrics.

claims.text: Models are evaluated based on the efficiency of the communication scheme, quantified by the retention rate of tokens, and the accuracy, measured by the fraction of sentences that match the target sentence.
A good communication scheme should minimize the number of keywords used while maximizing the probability of accurately reconstructing the target sentence.
The evaluation involves comparing the performance of the proposed autocomplete system against baselines in terms of accuracy and efficiency.
